fusions.name: Unspooling Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out with an unspooling length of cloth that deals 5 damage to an enemy up to 5 tiles away, up to 1.5 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Flying Shuttle
fusions.desc: Throws a loom shuttle that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Silk Cocoon
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a cocoon of thread for 4 seconds: blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Invisible Mending
fusions.desc: Every ability you use weaves a thread onto you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per thread (25% at full). Unfed, a thread fades every 10 seconds.
